svg.title: BF16 versus NVFP4 staged training — time flows top to bottom
svg.desc: A two-lane tensor and operation DAG comparing BF16 and NVFP4 staged forward and backward execution. The main MoE execution path is centered and time flows from top to bottom.
svg.text: BF16 versus NVFP4 staged training — time flows top to bottom
Blue: tensor · Orange solid: one kernel launch boundary · Orange dashed: alternate kernel · Green: saved for backward · Gray: state/synchronization
TIME FLOWS TOP → BOTTOM ↓ main MoE path stays centered
